arguments.command:
cat >> .github/workflows/ci.yml <<'EOF'

  commitlint:
    # Every commit of a pull request follows commitlint.config.js, whoever made it (pi included). Hooks can be
    # skipped with --no-verify; this check cannot.
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts

      - name: Check commit messages
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: npx --no -- commitlint --from "$BASE_SHA" --to "$HEAD_SHA" --verbose
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='CONTRIBUTING.md'; s=open(p).read()
a="| [`ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) | Runs `npm run check` on pushes and pull requests to `main` |"
b="| [`ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) | Runs `npm run check` on pushes and pull requests to `main`. On pull requests, the `commitlint` job checks the message of each commit with [`commitlint.config.js`](commitlint.config.js) |"
assert a in s; s=s.replace(a,b); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
npm run lint 2>&1 | tail -3
# verify commitlint locally: passes on our commits, fails on a bad one
npx --no -- commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD --verbose 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "exit=$?"
git commit -q --allow-empty --no-verify -m "release: v0.35.1"; npx --no -- commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD 2>&1 | tail -4; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; git reset -q --hard HEAD~1 2>/dev/null; git status --short
